capabilities: extract text from images with AI vision models
replace image embeds with extracted text
batch-extract text from a folder of images
route output to cursor, note, or new files with templates
extras: Full documentation lives in a separate Plugin Wiki (placeholders, rate limits, privacy). Installation via the Community Plugin Browser is not yet available; BRAT or manual installation are offered. Custom OpenAI-compatible providers are untested. OpenAI requires a user or service account key, not an sk-proj key. A proxy may be used to fetch external images and may temporarily log metadata for up to 7 days.
problem: Traditional OCR tools like Tesseract handle images poorly, and Obsidian has no built-in way to convert embedded images into text.

relations.evidence: Run models like llava, llava:13b, or bakllava entirely on your machine
Requires LM Studio to be installed and running

requires.name: OpenAI or Google API key for cloud models
Ollama or LM Studio for local models

summary: OCR plugin that extracts text and handwriting from images into notes using AI vision models from OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, or LM Studio.
